overview: Nether Tunnels form the deep under-network beneath Dawnshroud Peaks.
details: Volcanic fissures and ancient predator tunnels intersect with resonance bleed-through from Echo Caverns. Grimlings use the tunnels for covert movement.
hooks: A volcanic fissure opens a new tunnel toward The Grey.
Predators migrate upward from the deep chambers.
Resonance pulses distort sound and movement.
Grimlings attempt to seize a volcanic chamber for rituals.
